summary: All self-update logic has been successfully removed from Grove. The internal/updater package (525 lines of implementation + 402 lines of tests) was deleted, all updater imports removed from main.go and app.go, orphaned dead code cleaned up (selfUpdateDoneMsg type, selfUpdating field, orphaned case handler), documentation updated (README.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md), build passes successfully, all tests pass, and go vet reports no issues. The implementation cleanly achieves the objective: Grove no longer attempts automatic self-updates and relies exclusively on platform installers.

go test ./... passes all tests (14 packages, 0.8s); go vet ./... reports no issues

residualRisks.risk: Breaking change: Users can no longer self-update from within Grove binary and must use platform installers (curl/irm scripts) or build from source manually
residualRisks.mitigation: CHANGELOG.md and README.md clearly document new update procedure with exact commands for each platform; migration path provided in "Staying Up to Date" section
